meta.title: Sign in — Overberg Skills Connect
meta.description: Sign in to the Overberg Skills Connect admin dashboard.

errors.weakOrBreachedPassword: That password is too weak or has appeared in a known data breach. Please choose a stronger password that meets all the requirements shown.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please verify your email first. Check your inbox (and spam folder) for the confirmation link.
errors.alreadyRegistered: An account already exists for that email. Try signing in instead, or reset your password.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.networkError: We could not reach the server. Please check your internet connection and try again.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right. Please check it and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again, or use “Forgot password?” if you cannot sign in.

toasts.invalidVerificationLink: That verification link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one below.
toasts.emailVerifiedWelcome: Your email is verified. Welcome to Overberg Skills Connect!
toasts.passwordRequirementsNotMet: Please choose a password that meets all the requirements.
toasts.checkEmailToConfirm: Check your email to confirm your account.
toasts.passwordResetEmailSent: Password reset email sent. Check your inbox.
toasts.verificationResent: Verification email resent. Please check your inbox and spam folder.

confirmEmail.heading: Confirm your email
confirmEmail.body: We've sent a verification link to {{email}}. Click the link in that email to activate your account.
confirmEmail.checkSpam: Check your spam or junk folder.
confirmEmail.checkAddress: Make sure the email address is correct.
confirmEmail.linksExpire: Links expire — request a new one if needed.

intro.forgot: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
intro.default: Sign in or create a free account to advertise your skills, request contact details, and manage your activity.

google.reassurance: Google is only used to sign you in. We do not access your emails, contacts or files.

forgot.sentMessage: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam).

form.breachedNote: For your safety, common or breached passwords are also rejected.

switch.newHere: New here? Creating an account is free and takes about a minute.

meta.title: Reset password — Hineni
meta.description: Set a new password for your Hineni account.

invalid.title: This reset link is no longer valid.
invalid.explanation: Reset links can only be opened once and expire quickly. Email providers like Gmail sometimes preview links automatically, which uses them up before you click.
invalid.callToAction: Request a fresh link below and open it in your browser as soon as it arrives.
invalid.sentMessage: If an account exists for that email, a new reset link is on its way. Open it right away — don't hover or preview it first.

ready.intro: Choose a strong new password for your account.

toasts.newResetLinkSent: New reset link sent. Open it as soon as it arrives.
